mapper.sql: SELECT menu_id, menu_name, parent_id, order_num, path, component, `query`, is_frame, is_cache, menu_type, visible, STATUS, ifnull(perms, '') AS perms, icon, create_time FROM tb_special_menu
mapper.select: SELECT srm.role_id, srm.menu_id, sm.perms FROM tb_special_role_menu srm LEFT JOIN tb_special_menu sm on sm.menu_id =srm.menu_id WHERE srm.role_id = #{roleId}

SELECT m.menu_id FROM tb_special_menu m LEFT JOIN tb_special_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id WHERE rm.role_id = #{roleId}
ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.order_num

SELECT DISTINCT m.menu_id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.path, m.component, m.`query`, m.visible, m.STATUS, ifnull(m.perms, '') AS perms, m.is_frame, m.is_cache, m.menu_type, m.icon, m.order_num, m.create_time FROM tb_special_menu m WHERE m.menu_type IN ('M', 'C') AND m.STATUS = 0 ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.order_num

SELECT DISTINCT m.menu_id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.path, m.component, m.`query`, m.visible, m.STATUS, ifnull(m.perms, '') AS perms, m.is_frame, m.is_cache, m.menu_type, m.icon, m.order_num, m.create_time FROM tb_special_menu m LEFT JOIN tb_special_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.menu_id LEFT JOIN tb_special_role_user u ON u.role_id = rm.role_id LEFT JOIN tb_special_role r ON r.role_id = u.role_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.special_id = #{specialId} AND m.menu_type IN ('M', 'C') AND m.STATUS = 0 AND r.STATUS = 0 ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.order_num
